explanation: Request asks for Q2 = -0.5 GeV^2, which is timelike virtuality. EXCLURAD's Q2 input is the positive magnitude of spacelike virtuality (Q2 = -q^2 > 0); it only models deeply-virtual/electroproduction kinematics. Negative Q2 is outside the physical model and not reinterpretable by this driver. The preflight check also reports Q2 = -0.5 outside the lookup-table grid [0, 5] GeV^2, which would force extrapolation. No input files are generated. If timelike kinematics or Q2=0 (real photoproduction) were intended, that is a different code path this MCP server does not drive.
